goal: Prevent candidate text from acting as an independent answer policy that bypasses the governed latent judgment state.
procedure: Add an intervention that removes the latent signal while making candidate surfaces maximally distinguishable; require equal candidate logits under zero latent state; then remove standalone candidate-only scoring features and projection bias so every candidate-specific score contains latent interaction.
constraints: candidate text remains available for comparison
decision_criteria: zero latent signal cannot rank candidates
normal latent signal can still compare candidates
padded candidates remain structurally excluded
authority: May repair public N0 judgment mechanics; may not claim behavioral sufficiency or open FINAL.
validation: Exact-head static suite later passed with the bypass proof retained.
failure_or_lesson: A differentiable candidate scorer can become a hidden second policy even when the architecture appears to route through latent state. Remove independent candidate-only decision channels, not just label them as comparison features.

goal: Make structural support query-relevant without collapsing Binder into downstream evidence-quality arbitration.
procedure: Construct a hard negative carrying the same relation key as a positive edge but unrelated to the query; falsify relation-key-equality supervision; preserve explicit scenario support annotations; keep reliability/recency/temporal/provenance neutral in Binder so the Executor can arbitrate them at the correct step.
constraints: relation-key match is necessary but not sufficient
query relevance differs from evidence quality
decision_criteria: same-relation irrelevant edge remains unsupported
query-relevant quality alternatives remain eligible
support stays exact-sparse and runtime-cardinality independent
authority: May correct public support semantics; may not move step-local arbitration upstream.
validation: Full-envelope static tests and curriculum audits retained criterion-neutral Binder behavior while rejecting same-relation shortcut support.
failure_or_lesson: Structural support is not relation-label membership. A builder must separate semantic/query relevance from evidence-quality arbitration or it will train a shortcut instead of the intended causal role.

goal: Require model-free evidence that shortcut baselines cannot clear the operator/judgment gate before any gradient run.
procedure: Implement template-only, lexical-overlap, metadata-only, schema-only, query-only, hard-negative, candidate-permutation and factor-majority probes; materialize auditable source/target role counterfactuals; then add matched context-swaps holding query and candidate set fixed while changing evidence so the correct candidate changes.
constraints: same candidate set/order in context swap
decision_criteria: no shortcut baseline clears the governed gate
counterfactual pairs cover split/relation families
matched evidence swap changes public target while candidate surfaces stay fixed
authority: May block training when shortcut evidence is unsafe; may not tune thresholds after candidate results.
validation: PASS_N0_FULL_ENVELOPE_SHORTCUT_PREFLIGHT_V1 is now a required exact-head static receipt.
failure_or_lesson: Split isolation and a green task loss do not prove semantic learning. Cheap model-free baselines and matched evidence swaps should be executable prerequisites, not informal review notes.

goal: Ensure relational outputs represent probability mass that actually both executes a relation and later reaches STOP completion.
procedure: First block fully truncated programs. Then construct disjoint probability branches where one stops before relation execution and another only truncates; use the failure to reject marginal P(start)*P(not truncated). Replace it with exact STOP-conditioned completed-program mass and condition relation summaries/path execution on steps belonging to branches that later complete.
constraints: STOP at slot zero is non-relational
UNKNOWN/truncated branches cannot contaminate completed semantics
decision_criteria: disjoint start/completion branches yield zero relational completion
later relations that exist only on incomplete branches cannot alter completed summary/frontier
multi-hop length cannot inflate confidence
authority: May repair recurrent execution probability semantics; may not infer empirical competence from static correctness.
validation: Exact-head workflow 35778942888 passed 139 tests, 125 proof obligations and 110 static obligations.
failure_or_lesson: Products of reasonable-looking marginals can fabricate an impossible joint event. For probabilistic control flow, derive and test the exact joint event the product claims to represent.

goal: Make runtime qualification exercise the same semantic surfaces and no-ceiling policy intended for the real full-envelope system.
procedure: Route the dedicated long-context fixture through the actual query path; virtualize internal and additional runtime-view descriptors as well as query/relation/factor/field/candidate surfaces; require per-surface receipts; rename max_text_tokens to an explicit fixture operating point and fail if it is presented as a capability ceiling.
decision_criteria: every text-bearing surface proves shared virtualization policy
dedicated long fixture causally enters the query path
runtime fixture limits are declared non-ceilings
authority: May qualify runtime construction and resource footprint; may not authorize training until all prerequisite gates pass.
validation: Static contract audit passed at later exact heads; external Magnolia CPU execution remains intentionally unrun while source audit continues.
failure_or_lesson: A runtime smoke test is weak if it exercises easier surfaces or encodes fixture sizes as product limits. Qualification must mirror topology and semantic interfaces, not just instantiate similarly named modules.

goal: Create a successor FINAL package that is independent of TRAIN/DEV and frozen before gradient without reusing superseded legacy final authority.
procedure: Expose the missing successor package as a failing static obligation; define final-only synthetic extrapolation rows plus the sealed FewRel natural-final component; audit entity/template/field/candidate/domain/type-schema overlap and heldout factor combinations; hash-bind package/evaluator/contracts; freeze the package before gradient while candidate model results remain unopened.
constraints: legacy final v1/v3 cannot satisfy successor closure
no candidate results observed during build/audit/freeze
no final rows in training or checkpoint selection
decision_criteria: all independence audits pass
final axes exceed TRAIN/DEV operating points where specified
FewRel relation families remain disjoint
registered evaluator targets N0FullEnvelopeTrainableSystemV1
freeze receipt says no gradient/optimizer/final opening
authority: May seal evaluation material before training; may not open FINAL, select checkpoints on it, or declare N0 complete.
validation: Exact-head CI emitted PASS_N0_FULL_ENVELOPE_FINAL_V2_PACKAGE_FROZEN_STATIC with results_observed=false and final_opening_authorized=false.
failure_or_lesson: A final contract without an executable sealed package is not independence. Freeze the actual artifacts and evaluator binding before gradient, and keep legacy finals historical rather than silently promoting them.
